newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices drop on poor quality.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices drop on poor quality.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices fell at the penultimate weekly auction of the season, brokers said on Tuesday.
Despite the presence of buyers for Pakistan, Poland and Afghanistan, the market declined due mainly to the poor quality of end-of-season teas.
Some 482,125 kg of teas were sold at the auction.
The average price was 52.91 taka per kg, 0.77 taka down from the previous sale.
The last auction of the season will be held on March 18 with an expected offer of 500,000 kg. ($1 = 42.75 taka)
